title: Bulk universality of random regular graphs
summary: We consider the adjacency matrix of a uniformly random simple $d$-regular graph on $N$ vertices. For every fixed $d\geq3$ and every fixed bulk energy, we prove that the rescaled eigenvalue point process converges to the $\mathrm{Sine}_1$ process with intensity $1/π$. We also establish universality of consecutive gaps at deterministic bulk labels and of fixed-energy correlation measures.
